The following events took place in '''44 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This year was known as '''Year 9''' before the [[Great ReSynchronization]].

==Events==
*The [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] begins and ends.<ref name="TSHW" />
*The [[True Mandalorians]] are wiped out at the [[Battle of Galidraan]] by the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] which ends the [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|Mandalorian Civil War]] and fragments the Death Watch.
*[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] gains a seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="Windate">{{DB|character|macewindu|Windu, Mace}} establishes that [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] ascended to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] 28 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after his birth, which [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] dates to [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]], 28 years before 44 BBY.</ref>
*[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] chooses a young [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="JvS:TEGttF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
*The [[Syndicat]] of [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]] is overthrown.
*[[Galacian Gubernatorial election, 44 BBY|Galacian Gubernatorial election]].<ref name="JA:TMotC">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]''</ref>
*[[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] contributes ships and crew to Senator [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin's]] [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|paramilitary force]].
*[[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] gains a seat on the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].
*[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] tech supervisor, [[Miro Daroon]], repairs sabotage at the Temple [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|caused]] by [[Xanatos]] and [[Bruck Chun]].
*[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] replaces [[Tyvokka/Legends|Tyvokka]] on the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].
*[[Mix Liddell]] wins the [[Landing Shootout]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]] for the tenth time; then gracefully retires undefeated.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref> {{Circa}}
*In order to escape [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] raids on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Mazie]] and her family settles on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and starts a [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]].<ref name="Path to Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>
*The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]] ended its [[74 BBY|thirty-year]] isolation.<ref name="Fight for Truth">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>
*[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] hosts a [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]] on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]].<ref name="DPN">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
*[[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Senate hearing]].
